evidence_quotes.O: I had been wanting to try Nikon to have an educated review of Canon's biggest rival, Nikon.
evidence_quotes.C: I clocked the download of 350 photos at just under 2:50 minutes which was faster than the Transcend.
evidence_quotes.E: I bought this for my Canon because I take my cameras with me hiking, walking through cities and for everyday photo shoots.
evidence_quotes.A: Oh, I hate writing this review as I so want to like this little recorder.
evidence_quotes.N: But one thing does annoy me and it's the short life of its battery. I needed three batteries while walking around Chicago yesterday taking 600 photos. This is unacceptable!
